d: Contestants face a snowy obstacle course in the hope of getting to the Winter Wipeout Zone.

You are about to see crashes, smashes and mud splashes on the cards as twenty contestants take on obstacle courses  they face different games like the Qualifier, the Sweeper, the Dizzy Dummies and the grand final on the Wipeout Zone.
Richard Hammond replays all the action from the series and presents some awards to those who have gone above and beyond.
Ten celebrities, including "Blue Peter" presenter Andy Akinwolere, actress Ali Bastian and rugby legend Martin Offiah, take on the might of "Total Wipeout."
The Dodgeball Men are back to create a big challenge for the contestants.
Richard Hammond returns with the jewel in the crown of the "Total Wipeout" calendar: "The Awards." Gongs are handed out to the heroes and heroines of series 2.
